findings.title: Account UI message now uses Java single-brace placeholders
findings.body: The other account UI error messages in this file use double-brace interpolation such as `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}`. This change replaces them with single-brace Java-style placeholders and adds a Java `ChoiceFormat` expression (`{2,choice,...}`). The account UI message layer will not substitute those placeholders, so users will see literal `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and the choice text instead of the attribute name and value count. Keep the JS interpolation syntax or format the plural in the UI.

findings.title: Admin UI message now uses Java single-brace placeholders
findings.body: This JS admin UI bundle uses double-brace placeholders (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`) throughout. The changed `error-invalid-multivalued-size` value uses single braces and a Java `ChoiceFormat` expression (`{2,choice,...}`), which the admin UI interpolation does not process. The result is a user-visible error message with literal placeholders rather than the attribute name and count.

findings.title: Lithuanian account message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` value is `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian account users will see Italian instructions after this change. The text needs to be restored to a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new `loginTotpStep1` value is `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian, not Lithuanian. This makes the Lithuanian login page show Italian instructions. It should be a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle contains Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` text `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional Chinese characters and Taiwan-style wording (`手機`, `應用程式`) in the `zh_CN` Simplified Chinese bundle. Users of the Simplified Chinese locale will see mixed script. It should be converted to Simplified Chinese.

findings.title: Sanitizer tests cover only rejection cases, not valid HTML
findings.body:
The added tests only verify that illegal HTML, unchanged anchor mismatches, and duplicate keys produce errors. There is no test proving that a translation containing HTML allowed by the English source (for example `
